comment: Waiver list for the anti-revert coverage ratchet (conformance-fix-signatures.spec.ts, the 'every branch-changed file is signature-covered or explicitly waived' spec). A file belongs here only if it was modified on this branch under src/sets or src/game AND genuinely should not be signature-protected — pure reorg, upstream-owned, no fix content. Anything else must be registered in fix-signatures.json instead, which is what actually makes a silent revert detectable. THIS LIST IS DEBT: it may shrink but should never grow casually, and every entry needs a real reason, not a placeholder.
history: Seeded EMPTY on 2026-08-01. It was designed to absorb a 468-file backlog (455 src/sets + 13 src/game changed with no signature), but that backlog was paid down instead rather than blessed: 447 card files bulk-registered via register_fix_signatures.py, 3 more after its candidate generator was taught to look past block prefixes, 5 deletion-type evolvesFrom fixes registered via the new absentSignatures mechanism, and all 13 engine files registered by hand with load-bearing lines. Coverage is therefore 695/695 and the spec is a strict assertion.

waived.ptcg-server/src/sets/11-mega-evolution/s: 2026-09-01: the branch's only change is a 3-line provenance COMMENT (TA-256 / upstream f0edbdac4). The fix itself — MEP set, regulationMark 'I', MEP index registration — exists at origin/main verbatim, so a take-upstream merge reverts nothing; the former signature entry was removed 2026-08-31 for exactly that (non-discriminating: present at HEAD AND upstream). Nothing to protect.
waived.ptcg-server/src/sets/06-black-and-white/: 2026-09-07 (upstream merge 56865ad0d): BYTE-IDENTICAL to origin/main, so a take-upstream merge reverts nothing and no signature could discriminate. Our ef62eef66 fix (`provides: [...this.provides]`, one COLORLESS placeholder, flexible types in `blendedEnergies`) was SUPERSEDED, not lost: upstream 9e6e302fd deleted `blendedEnergies` and now lists the real types in `provides`, with StateUtils.isChoosableProvides making a multi-type provides ONE choosable unit — the same contract, enforced in the shared algorithm instead of per-card. The contract is guarded behaviourally by the Haxorus sfa-046 + 1 Blend WLFM cell in conformance-cardlogic-regressions.spec.ts (one Blend pays [F], never [F][M]) and by state-utils.spec.ts; both green. Flagged here only because the guard's baseline is the merge-base, which predates upstream's rewrite.
2026-09-07: see blend-energy-wlfm.ts — same fix, same upstream supersession, byte-identical to origin/main, same behavioural guard.
waived.ptcg-server/src/sets/10-scarlet-and-viol: 2026-09-07 (upstream merge 56865ad0d): BYTE-IDENTICAL to origin/main. TA-289 (Metronome's inline copy owed the AfterAttackEffect the direct route issues) was RELOCATED, not dropped: upstream 3ee8aac13 routed twm-079 and 27 other copy cards through the shared runDelegatedCopiedAttackGenerator, which does issue it. The fix is signature-protected at its new home, game/store/prefabs/copy-attack-delegation.ts, where we restored the 4th `attackEffect` argument that upstream's 3-arg call dropped — one line now covering all 28 converted cards instead of one per card.
